ad_slots.note: Ad placement lesson: this publication's ad network holds a fixed cap of accepted opportunities (3). Placing fresh offers from list_ad_offers auto-accepts them and fails with 'can not accept any more opportunities' once the cap is reached. The account already had 3 accepted opportunities (WorldQuant, CryptoLark, 1440 Media), so the correct move was to embed those accepted opportunity IDs (from list_ad_opportunities status=accepted) directly rather than placing new offers. Also: only ONE 'primary' (with-logo) ad slot is allowed per post; additional ads must use data-advertisement-kind='secondary'. Accepted-opportunity IDs are stable (unlike list_ad_offers IDs, which rotate every call).
